RAW SIZE

TOKEN ESTIMATE
  No real tokenizer (tiktoken / anthropic SDK) is installed in this environment,
  so the chars/3.5 heuristic specified by the task is used, cross-checked with a
  more conservative chars/4.0 (English prose typically runs ~3.5-4.2 chars/token;
  the Anthropic tokenizer sits in that band for plain instructional prose).

  chars / 3.5  = 5146 est. tokens   <-- primary heuristic
  chars / 4.0  = 4502 est. tokens   <-- conservative cross-check

HAIKU 4.5 CACHE FLOOR
  Minimum cacheable prefix = 4096 tokens (docs/research/worker-llm-facts.md §2).

  Primary heuristic margin : 1050 tokens  (25.6% over floor)
  Conservative margin      : 406 tokens  (9.9% over floor)

RESULT
  PASS. Segment A clears the 4096-token cache floor under BOTH estimates, and
  clears the task's >=4600 est.-token target (chars/3.5 = 5146) with the required
  ~10% margin. Because even the conservative chars/4.0 estimate (4502) exceeds
  4096, the shared prefix is expected to actually cache on Haiku 4.5 rather than
  silently returning cache_creation_input_tokens: 0.

VERIFY-AT-RUNTIME (red-team harness, not doable offline here)
  The authoritative check is a live token count. Either:
    (a) POST Segment A to the Anthropic /v1/messages/count_tokens endpoint, or
    (b) assert usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0 from interview turn 2 onward.
  If a real count ever lands below 4096, add material (do NOT pad with filler) to
  Segment A and DO NOT reorder — Segment A must stay byte-stable across renders.
